insight: Open-core: its serverless GPU runtime is open-sourced as beam-cloud/beta9, while the managed cloud adds scaling and sandboxes on top.
name: Beam
tagline: On-demand serverless GPU compute for AI, from Python.
description: A serverless cloud for deploying AI inference endpoints, agent sandboxes, task queues, and containerized GPU workloads with a few lines of Python. It handles fast cold starts, autoscaling, and Docker-in-Docker execution across multiple cloud backends, and supports bring-your-own-compute. The Developer tier is free with recurring monthly credit; paid tiers add team features and scale, billed pay-as-you-go by GPU usage.
